title: Rock Album Cover with Star and Bold Typography
coreRelationships: The large central star emblem dominates the lower two-thirds of the composition.
The text 'ATTENTION SHOPPERS!' is positioned above and to the left of the star, creating a visual hierarchy.
The yellow outlines and fills provide strong contrast against the red shapes and black background.
The angularity of the 'STARZ' lettering is echoed in the points of the star and the wing-like extensions.
The distressed, italicized text at the top contrasts with the clean, bold lines of the central emblem.
reuseFormula: Recreate the solid black background with a thin red border. Position a large, red five-pointed star with a thick yellow outline centrally, adding yellow horizontal wing-like elements. Overlay custom yellow angular lettering for 'STARZ' within the star. Above and to the left, place distressed, italicized red text 'ATTENTION SHOPPERS!' at an upward angle.
typographyText: dominant · custom-lettering · The 'ATTENTION SHOPPERS!' text has a sans-serif, slightly condensed, italicized base. The 'STARZ' text has a custom, angular, wide sans-serif base. · For 'ATTENTION SHOPPERS!': Letters are slightly irregular and have a rough, almost hand-drawn or distressed edge. They are italicized and lean to the right. Stroke width is medium-bold. · For 'STARZ': Letters are constructed with sharp angles and straight lines, giving a blocky, almost stencil-like appearance. The 'S' features a distinctive three-bar horizontal element extending to the left. The 'A' has a pointed apex. The 'R' has a unique, almost 'K' like leg. The 'Z' is very angular. All letters are uppercase and wide. · The 'S' in 'STARZ' has a prominent three-bar horizontal extension to the left, integrated into the star's wing-like elements. · The 'A' in 'STARZ' has a sharp,
